readExcerpt.translation: “…and recite the Qur’an with measured recitation.”

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
dua.translation: “O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.”

hadith.translation: “The best among you are those who learn the Qur’an and teach it.”
